text: ‼️ 🇳🇱 Juventus CEO Giovanni Carnevali is considering making a move for Lazio midfielder Kenneth Taylor, as the Bianconeri continue to explore potential midfield reinforcements. The 24-year-old Dutch international has emerged as another interesting option for Juventus as the management evaluates ways to strengthen Luciano Spalletti’s squad. Taylor’s technical ability, tactical intelligence and versatility in midfield could make him an attractive addition to the Bianconeri. The Dutchman offers several qualities that could benefit Juventus: • Excellent technical ability and ball distribution. • Ability to operate in multiple midfield roles. • Intelligent movement and attacking contributions. • Experience at European and international level. • Significant potential for further development. ‼️ 🇩🇰 Juventus are working on a January deal for Pierre-Emile Højbjerg. The proposed formula is a loan with an option or conditional obligation to buy in June 2027, with a total valuation of around €15 million. The main obstacle is Marseille's demand for financial guarantees, as the French club would prefer to receive payment immediately. Højbjerg is attracted by the prospect of playing in Serie A, which could help Juventus find an agreement. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — Gazzetta_it

‼️ 🇹🇷 Kenan Yildiz could make his return to action around the middle of December, however, no definitive return date has been established, with the current recovery schedule still pointing towards the coming weeks. Kenan has been working with the ball for several days and is attempting to accelerate his rehabilitation programme. His progress represents an encouraging development, although the club remains cautious about rushing him back. With a metal plate in his foot, Yildiz’s recovery requires careful management to avoid unnecessary complications. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮— romeoagresti 𝓥𝓲𝓪 — Pueblo_Juve

‼️ 🇮🇹 JUVE MAKE CONTACT WITH ATALANTA FOR BERNASCONI Juventus have made direct contact with Atalanta over a possible move for Lorenzo Bernasconi. The Bianconeri had previously followed the left-back closely and are now exploring the possibility of signing him Atalanta have recently renewed Bernasconi's contract, but a move to Juventus next summer remains a possibility. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — CorSport

‼️ 🇲🇪 After a promising start to the season at Sassuolo, Vasilije Adzic has seen his playing time and impact decline. It remains uncertain whether Sassuolo will exercise their option to make his move permanent. Juventus are also monitoring his development to assess whether he can become an important talent for the club in the future. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮— CorSport

‼️ 🇮🇹 JUVENTUS INTERESTED IN GIANLUCA SCAMACCA AS POTENTIAL ATTACKING REINFORCEMENT Juventus are monitoring Atalanta striker Gianluca Scamacca, with Giovanni Carnevali, Ricky Massara and Luciano Spalletti all holding the Italian forward in high regard. The Bianconeri believe in Scamacca’s qualities and would be willing to give him the opportunity to revive his career in Turin. However, negotiating a potential deal would be far from straightforward. Atalanta are unwilling to offer any discounts, particularly to Juventus, whom they consider a direct rival in the race for European qualification. The Bergamo club would therefore be expected to maintain a firm position in any potential transfer negotiations. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮— tuttosport

‼️ 🇺🇸 Juventus have made their position clear regarding Weston McKennie’s future: the American midfielder is not for sale, unless any substantial offers are made for him. Given the club’s financial situation, Juventus cannot afford to automatically reject every proposal, particularly for a player approaching 29 years of age next August. A sufficiently attractive offer could therefore force the Bianconeri to reconsider their stance, despite Spalletti’s desire to keep McKennie. Regarding Luciano Spalletti, McKennie is considered untouchable and remains a fundamental part of his plans. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — tuttosport
